name: solidsforyou
description: SOLIDS FOR YOU: Make your Claude solid. Everything a founder needs, as Claude tools

plugins.name: audio-review
plugins.description: SOLIDS FOR YOU Audio Review: Claude listens to audio like a senior audio designer (loudness, dynamics, tonal balance, stereo, noise and artifacts) and gives a scored review with a fix list.

plugins.name: motion-design-taste
plugins.description: SOLIDS FOR YOU Motion Design Taste: Claude judges motion graphics videos like a senior motion designer, scores them out of 100, ranks them against references, and lists or applies exact fixes.

plugins.name: harsh-buyer-review
plugins.description: SOLIDS FOR YOU Harsh Buyer Review: Claude becomes a real buyer, researches your competitors, compares one-on-one, and gives brutally specific feedback on listings, images, video, copy and price.

plugins.name: careful-mode
plugins.description: SOLIDS FOR YOU Careful Mode: Claude reviews every piece of work three times (correctness, completeness, how could this go wrong) before handing it over.

plugins.name: economy-mode
plugins.description: SOLIDS FOR YOU Economy Mode: Claude sends simple tasks to cheaper models (Haiku, Sonnet) and keeps the strongest model for decisions and review, to cut cost.

plugins.name: master
plugins.description: SOLIDS FOR YOU Master Skill: on in every session, it has Claude use only the SOLIDS FOR YOU tools each task needs, to save credits and raise quality: the full video workflow (plan, build, review, fix and re-render until it scores 85+), social media, feedback and research get their specialists; simple tasks get none. You can switch it to task-specific.

plugins.name: social-media
plugins.description: SOLIDS FOR YOU Social Media: Claude becomes your head of social media. Strategy, content calendars, posts, hooks, carousels and reel scripts for every major platform, a 100-point pre-publish scorecard, honest growth rules, and analytics that learn what works for your account.

plugins.name: competitor-research
plugins.description: SOLIDS FOR YOU Competitor Research: deep competitor analysis on any marketplace (Amazon, Flipkart, Meesho and more), competitor websites, social media and ad libraries. Every fact is sourced and dated, a separate pass verifies it, scripts do the maths, and the research runs on Haiku to save credits.
